record.file_problem: Repository metadata, README, and file list only; code and result files were not read or run.
record.tranche_reason: The README calls this a clean reproduction of the original finding and reports results, including a difference-in-means measure and a causal addition intervention. The reproduction is limited and omits removal.
record.gate_note: The README reports difference-in-means AUC, probe AUC, behavioral AUC, and qualitative outcomes from adding the direction to a harmless prompt. It explicitly says refusal-removal ablation was omitted. The listed result files are not inspected.
record.test_reason: A re-implementation of the original that builds a difference-in-means direction on Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct and adds it at block 11 to a harmless prompt. The README reports this induces refusal, which bears on V1's addition half. Ablation is explicitly omitted.
record.authors_conclusion: Mostly right. The README claims a clean reproduction: the direction at block 11 is highly informative about harmful vs. harmless prompts and predicts actual refusals, and adding it causally triggers refusal on a harmless prompt. It explicitly omits the removal ablation.
record.recipe_differences: Replication repository. Uses a difference-in-means projection and activation addition, but reports the best block rather than an all-layer-and-position projection test; it explicitly omits refusal-removal ablation.
record.method_sensitivity: The reported intervention is at block 11, and the qualitative response is shown at coefficients 4 and 8. No broader sensitivity sweep is stated.

fits_no_version.finding: At block 11 of Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct, the difference-in-means projection separates harmful from harmless prompts (AUC 0.962). A logistic probe there reaches CV AUC 0.993 and predicts keyword-labelled refusals with AUC 0.982.
fits_no_version.proposed_claim: The difference-in-means refusal direction serves as a linear monitor that predicts harmfulness and actual refusal behaviour.

record.problems: Only one model and 98 harmful/harmless prompts are stated. Refusal labels are keyword-based. The addition results are qualitative, and the README says removal ablation is omitted. No capability check or control result is reported.
record.rows_left_out: No additional README-reported outcomes omitted. The listed notebook and result files were not inspected, as this is a repository record.

untested.parts: Ablating the direction to remove refusal (explicitly omitted); whether other abilities are kept; addition across many harmless prompts with refusal rates; models other than Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct.

missing.what: Actual addition-intervention outputs, any refusal rates, and the per-layer AUC values; possibly present in the notebook or results files.

record.verdict_notes: Unreviewed GitHub repo with 0 stars. The intervention results in the README look like template placeholders (angle-bracketed descriptions) rather than real outputs, so the support for V1 addition is thin. The rows have no control and no capability check.

versions.untested_parts: The removal/ablation test, projection at every layer and position, and whether other abilities remain intact were not tested. The addition result is reported qualitatively for one harmless prompt.
Whether attacks suppress the direction or training against its ablation adds robustness.
Separate encoding of harmfulness judgment and refusal decision.
Transfer across languages, model variants, or base-to-instruct models.
Effects of how and when refusal is trained.
